description: Machine-readable seed of the intake profile schema: one entry per data point in intake/profile_schema_mapping.md (v0.2), sections 1-8. This file is configuration, not code - the interview engine, evidence-request compiler and profile page all read it. It defines NO new emissions data points: every entry either populates an existing methodology field, sets an intake-only state/content field, or triggers a J2 evidence request.
design_contracts: Every populates entry of target_type 'methodology_field' must resolve to a field_id present in intake/config/methodology_field_index.json, and each schema_field must be one of that field's real Data_Schema_Field(s).
Every evidence_triggered ID must be a J2 evidence type ID present in reference-data/config/libraries/evidence_type_library.json.

question_content_ref values are placeholders. Final plain-language wording, explainers and the film vocabulary overlay are authored after the Vocabulary Library review (SPEC section 10) and are not part of this seed.

Entries with provisional true encode a proposed default that is NOT yet methodologically approved. They must surface for expert review (Todd) and must never be silently applied as settled - CLAUDE.md rule 6.
class_source records whether the escalation class came from the mapping or was inferred by implementation and still needs confirmation.
applicability.condition_ref names a condition defined in applicability_conditions. Evaluation logic is deterministic application code built in Phase C; this seed only names the conditions.

A negative screening answer produces a 'screened, not present' completeness record (intake state), never an EXC-010 exclusion. EXC-010 is reserved for sources that exist and are excluded on materiality grounds.

pending_class_confirmation.note: The mapping does not assign an escalation class to these entries; the class below was inferred during Phase A and needs founder/expert confirmation.

mapping_shorthand_resolved.resolution: FAC-010 exposes period_in_scope_start and period_in_scope_end; both are encoded. Mapping wording is a shorthand, not a missing field.

not_in_scope_v1.note: SPEC section 8 scope cuts. Recorded here so the exclusion is traceable rather than silently absent.

sections.label: Boundary
sections.description: Boundary block. HUMAN class unless noted; human-confirmed before lock.

sections.label: Scope 1 - mobile
sections.description: Per-entity screening for vehicles and motorized equipment.

sections.label: Scope 1 - fugitives and process
sections.description: Per-site screening for refrigerants, fire suppression, industrial gases and process sources.

sections.label: Scope 2
sections.description: Per-site imported energy: electricity, district energy, self-generation, instruments.

sections.label: Method routing defaults
sections.description: SME path cut. SYSTEM class, verifier-overridable, never asked of the client.

sections.label: Provenance and data quality
sections.description: Applies to every data point above: source/provenance capture and category-level uncertainty.

industry_is_film.description: Client's industry overlay is the film production overlay (SEED-1.4).

more_than_one_legal_entity.description: The org comprises more than one legal entity. Skipped entirely for single-entity SMEs.

prior_inventories_exist.description: The client has previously prepared a GHG inventory, so base year is not simply the first reporting year.

stationary_or_mobile_fuel_present.description: A positive answer to stationary fuel use, generators, or a mobile fleet, so fuel blend composition matters.

screening_answer_negative.description: A screening question in sections 3-6 was answered 'no'; triggers a completeness record rather than an exclusion.

mobile_fleet_present.description: The client owns or leases vehicles or motorized equipment (S1MOB-4.1 positive).

selling_energy_or_attributes.description: The client sells self-generated power or its environmental attributes, creating double-counting risk.

answer_is_yes.description: The client answered 'yes' to the screening question on this data point.

datapoints.label: Company legal name + reporting year
datapoints.reasoning: Anchor keys for the whole inventory; every S1/S2 record joins back to INV-010.

datapoints.label: Responsible party: name, role, email of the person accountable for the inventory
datapoints.reasoning: ISO 14064-1 report content requires naming the responsible party. Doubles as the client-side escalation contact for the alert pipeline.
notes: Added in mapping v0.2 (audit FAIL 6).
Surfaces in report content; no methodology field ID holds this today.

datapoints.label: Sites: name, full address, status
datapoints.reasoning: Facility register is the grain everything else attaches to. Address feeds Scope 2 grid-region matching (S2-MTR-070 / S2-EFS-070) without asking the user - grid region is derived, never asked.
notes: Mapping writes 'period_in_scope'; FAC-010 exposes period_in_scope_start and period_in_scope_end. Both encoded - see open_items.mapping_shorthand_resolved.
Grid region is derived from this address, never asked of the client.

datapoints.label: Industry
datapoints.reasoning: Switches vocabulary/explainer overlay (film v1).
notes: v1 dropdown per SPEC stage 1: 'Film production facility' and 'General' only.

datapoints.label: Site type (film overlay: soundstage complex / backlot / office / workshop)
datapoints.reasoning: Drives which screening questions appear per site.
notes: Descriptive attribute on FAC-010; the methodology schema has no dedicated site_type field ID, so the value is held intake-side and mirrored to the legacy field.
Mapping writes 'audit_setup.facility_type'; real legacy path is company_and_facility_profile.facility_type.

datapoints.label: Reporting period start/end, fiscal basis
datapoints.reasoning: Required key for all consumption/period allocation.

datapoints.label: Own vs lease per site
datapoints.reasoning: Seed captures the raw fact; control determination is a boundary judgment.
notes: Partial capture only. The control determination is completed in the boundary block (BND-2.3), which is where the HUMAN confirmation happens.

datapoints.label: Consolidation approach (plain language: 'which parts of the business count as yours')

provisional_default.rationale: SME default proposal: single-entity SMEs converge on the same inventory under all three approaches. Human confirms.

datapoints.reasoning: Named options - operational control / financial control / equity share - exist in ORG-010 and the legacy audit_setup enum, and satisfy both GHG Protocol and ISO 14064-1. ISO additionally permits other documented, justified methods.
notes: ISO 14064-1 permits other consolidation methods if the organization documents and justifies them (mapping v0.2, suggestion 1).

datapoints.label: Operations/subsidiaries list (only if more than one legal entity)
datapoints.reasoning: Skipped entirely for single-entity SMEs - the common case.

datapoints.label: Leased/rented spaces and equipment: who controls what
datapoints.reasoning: The landlord/tenant crux. Determines whether a source is the client's Scope 1/2 or the tenant's. Never auto-parsed.
notes: Film framing: which stages are under studio control vs production control; who holds each meter.
Lease agreements are also requested as supporting evidence alongside J2-007.

datapoints.label: Base year

provisional_default.rationale: SME default: first reporting year = base year, with the standard recalculation policy template.

escalation_triggers.reason: Prior inventories mean the base year is a real methodology choice, not a default. J2-014 is requested.

datapoints.reasoning: AUTO with condition: the SME default applies unless prior inventories exist, in which case this escalates.
notes: J2-014 is requested only on the escalation path, not for every client.

datapoints.label: Mid-year acquisitions, divestitures or moves

escalation_triggers.reason: Rare for SMEs; a 'yes' is a boundary change that goes to a human.

datapoints.reasoning: Rare for SMEs; one yes/no screening question; 'yes' escalates.

datapoints.label: GWP set + gas universe

provisional_default.rationale: System assigns per program requirements; verifier can override. Defaults require expert sign-off before any value is set.

datapoints.reasoning: Methodology decision, not a client fact. System assigns per program requirements; verifier can override. Needs Todd sign-off on defaults.
notes: Never surfaced to the client as a question.
Mapping self-check also lists gas-universe alignment as a known integration caveat.

datapoints.label: Significance criteria + justification for excluding indirect categories 3-6 (ISO) / Scope 3 (GHG Protocol)

provisional_default.rationale: Templated default statement for SMEs, human-confirmed. Template content pending expert sign-off.

datapoints.reasoning: ISO 14064-1 requires a documented process for determining significant indirect emissions and justifying exclusions; a Scope-1-and-2-only inventory conforms only with this recorded.
notes: Added in mapping v0.2 (audit FAIL 3).
Applied at indirect-category level (ISO categories 3-6), not at individual source level.

datapoints.label: Any equipment on site that burns fuel? (heating boilers, gas kitchens, workshops) - yes/no + list
datapoints.reasoning: 'Yes' activates the STC block; per-fuel records land in S1-STC-110/010 from extracted documents, not typed answers.
notes: Method claim S1-STC-140 is defaulted per section 7 (MRT-7.1).
J2-008 registers the equipment; J2-001/J2-003 follow per fuel type.
Consumption quantities are never typed by the client - they come from extracted documents into S1-STC-110/S1-STC-010.

datapoints.label: Any backup or emergency generators?
datapoints.reasoning: Schema provides the emergency-generator estimation path (S1-STC-220/230, EPA section 3.1 p.9).
notes: Film overlay default expectation: yes for stages.
Activity-estimation route S1-STC-220 applies when generator fuel is not separately metered; estimated quantity lands in S1-STC-230.

datapoints.label: Is any of your fuel biodiesel, renewable diesel, or a blend?
datapoints.reasoning: ISO 14064-1 requires biogenic CO2 quantified separately; the workbook's biogenic routes exist but were never activated by a screening question. Renewable diesel in generators is increasingly common at studios.
notes: Added in mapping v0.2 (audit FAIL 4).
Outputs route via S1-STC-330/340/350, which carry emissions_co2_biogenic separately from emissions_co2_fossil.
Applies to mobile fuels too, via S1-MOB-310.

datapoints.label: Screening 'no' produces a 'screened, not present' completeness record
datapoints.reasoning: Non-existence is a completeness statement, not an exclusion. EXC-010 (exclusion_rationale, exclusion_materiality_basis) is reserved for sources that exist but are excluded with justification.
notes: Revised in mapping v0.2 (audit FAIL 5).
Applies to all 'no' answers across sections 3-6, not only stationary combustion.
This rule must never write EXC-010. Genuine exclusions require sustentra_reviewer action per SPEC section 4.

datapoints.label: Vehicles or motorized equipment the company owns/leases? + fleet list
datapoints.reasoning: J2-004's own default rule is flag_by_default when ownership/control is unclear; intake asks ownership explicitly per vehicle group to pre-clear it.
notes: Mapping class is 'AUTO with flag': the J2-004 flag_by_default rule is pre-cleared by asking ownership explicitly per vehicle group.
Film framing: carts, forklifts, shuttles, trucks.

datapoints.label: Do productions/tenants bring their own vehicles?
datapoints.reasoning: Tenant vehicles are out of scope; recording why is boundary judgment.
notes: Film-only question.
Recorded as tenant-side, out of client scope - a boundary record, not an emissions record.

datapoints.label: Fuel data availability: fuel-card records vs only mileage
datapoints.reasoning: Schema supports fuel-based and distance/fuel-economy routes; intake picks based on documents the client actually has.
notes: Biodiesel/blend flag for mobile fuels is carried by S1STC-3.3 via S1-MOB-310.
Mileage-log evidence uses the J2-009 pattern.

datapoints.label: AC or refrigeration systems your company maintains? + equipment count/type
datapoints.reasoning: Screening-factor route works from equipment data alone; material-balance route (S1-FUG-110) upgrades it when service records exist - intake asks 'do you have service invoices?' to pick.
notes: The service-invoice availability sub-question selects between the material-balance and screening routes (see MRT-7.4).

datapoints.label: Fire suppression systems using gas agents (not water sprinklers)?
datapoints.reasoning: Plain-language wording must distinguish water sprinklers (no GHG) from clean-agent/CO2 systems.
notes: Question content requirement: the wording must make the water-sprinkler distinction explicit, otherwise clients over-report.

datapoints.label: Purchase any industrial gases? (CO2, welding gas, special effects gases)
datapoints.reasoning: Film-relevant: CO2/N2O for effects are Scope 1 when released.
notes: Purchase invoices follow the J2-003 pattern.

datapoints.label: On-site wastewater treatment or other industrial processes?

escalation_triggers.reason: The workbook flags process (PRC) calculations as unsupported for automation; a 'yes' always goes to a human.

datapoints.reasoning: Workbook flags process (PRC) calculations as unsupported for automation. Rare for SMEs; always goes to a human.
notes: Screening only - intake records presence, it does not attempt any PRC calculation routing.

datapoints.label: SF6 electrical equipment
datapoints.reasoning: Workbook flags full SF6 electrical accounting as unsupported for automation; SME prevalence approximately zero. Verifier-side only.
notes: NOT ASKED in v1 (mapping 5.5, SPEC section 8 scope cut). Recorded here so the omission is traceable rather than silently absent.
The mapping assigns no escalation class to this row; SYSTEM was inferred during Phase A and needs confirmation.

datapoints.label: Electricity accounts: supplier, account/meter numbers, how many meters
datapoints.reasoning: Consumption quantities (S2-CON-020/025) come from extracted bills, never typed. Grid region (S2-MTR-070) derived from FAC-010 address.
notes: Evidence expectation is J2-002 x 12 months per meter; the expected-completeness spec is compiled in Phase E from this.
Grid region S2-MTR-070 and EF geographic match S2-EFS-070 are derived from the site address, never asked.

datapoints.label: Shared building or shared meters with tenants/others? + floor areas
datapoints.reasoning: Allocation basis is judgment; human confirms before S1 processes dependent documents.
notes: Submeter reports use the J2-009 pattern; lease terms use J2-007.

datapoints.label: Purchased steam, hot water, or chilled water?
datapoints.reasoning: Asked per site as yes/no; never assumed.
notes: District energy bills follow the J2-002 pattern.

datapoints.label: On-site solar or other generation? Sell any power back?

escalation_triggers.reason: Selling energy or attributes creates double-counting risk (OPB-040); that branch escalates to HUMAN.

datapoints.reasoning: Mapping class is 'AUTO; HUMAN if selling'. Selling energy or attributes creates double-counting risk (OPB-040) - that branch escalates.
notes: OPB-040 (double_counting_check) is the downstream check the escalation exists to protect.
Generation records follow the J2-009 pattern.

datapoints.label: Bought renewable energy certificates or a green power product?
datapoints.reasoning: Instruments activate market-based reporting alongside location-based (GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance dual reporting, conditional on instrument markets - applies in the US). J2-019's rules guard the classic error (RECs netted against Scope 1).
notes: Dual reporting: location-based is always produced; market-based is added when instruments exist.

datapoints.label: Stationary combustion method route default

conditional_routes.condition: bills are expressed in energy units

datapoints.reasoning: SME path cut: expose only the simple routes. Verifier can override.
notes: Route values are controlled Calculation_Method values from the methodology workbooks.
'complex waste gas' has no controlled Calculation_Method value; recorded descriptively.

datapoints.label: Emergency generator method route default

conditional_routes.condition: generator fuel is not separately metered

datapoints.reasoning: Activity estimation is the schema's provided path when generator fuel is unmetered.

datapoints.label: Mobile combustion method route default

conditional_routes.condition: only mileage is available; distance x fuel-economy fallback

datapoints.reasoning: Fuel-based from fuel cards; distance x fuel-economy fallback when only mileage exists.

datapoints.label: Fugitive method route default

conditional_routes.condition: no service records available; screening factors fallback

datapoints.reasoning: Material balance from service records; screening factors fallback.
notes: The service-invoice availability sub-question on S1FUG-5.1 selects between these two routes.

datapoints.label: Scope 2 method route default
datapoints.reasoning: Billed consumption; location-based always, market-based added when instruments exist.
notes: Location-based is never replaced by market-based; the two are reported together.

datapoints.label: Source provenance: document type, period covered, metered vs invoiced vs estimated
datapoints.reasoning: Per the inventory-management-plan concept in the EPA/GHG Protocol guidance already cited in the workbooks.
notes: value_basis is the metered / invoiced / estimated distinction.
Film addition: lease/license agreements, submeter reports, generator rental invoices are recognised source document types.
The mapping assigns no escalation class to section 8; AUTO was inferred during Phase A and needs confirmation.

datapoints.label: Uncertainty assessment: category-level rating with qualitative justification
datapoints.reasoning: ISO 14064-1 section 8.3 requires uncertainty assessed at category level, with qualitative assessment justified when quantitative isn't feasible/cost-effective. The metered/invoiced/estimated field supplies approximately 80% of the input; this adds the roll-up and justification fields.
notes: Added in mapping v0.2 (audit FAIL 2).
Rolls up from PRV-8.1 value_basis across each data point in the category.
The mapping assigns no escalation class to section 8; HUMAN was inferred during Phase A because the qualitative justification is a methodology judgment. Needs confirmation.
